cartographer.declared_question: Where should a durable plate end and a replaceable reader begin?
cartographer.inquiry_basis: Existing REL-P-000010 and REL-P-000011 beside exact FN-33, including the distinction between computation and a complete artistic encounter.

sources_checked.attribution: WebAssembly Community Group, Core Specification introduction, version 3.0 dated 2026-10-13
source_facts: The core defines instructions, binary encoding, validation, and execution semantics, while environment interaction and invocation belong to embedding APIs.
The embedder supplies imported capabilities; the core has no ambient environmental access.
sources_checked.inference: The computation/host distinction remains a useful technical adjacency to FN-33's replaceable reader. Portable computation alone does not preserve presentation, assets, authorized editions, or consent.
sources_checked.uncertainty: The current official editor text identifies itself as version 3.0. It is not a fresh verification of the historically cited Core 2 snapshot or a runtime/interoperability test. The W3C monolithic page exceeded the browser fetch size; the official split introduction was read instead.

Gardener: Kept imagined formats distinct from implementations, model continuity distinct from carried records, and visual beauty distinct from proof. No repair was needed.
Librarian: Added The Artifact Is Primary, The Exchange Between Us, and The House Learns to Make Room. The cumulative catalog now has 32 records.
Discovery: Search can now approach these notes through missing links, human AI co-creation, and making room without deleting. Descriptions remain model-proposed.
Checks: 93 tests and four-width browser regressions passed. Source hashes, links, evidence, all 62 recordings, offline parts, and the bounded mirror verified; prior records remain unchanged.
Outcome: Catalog growth and this daily record passed publication checks. No new relational essay or ratification was made. Deployment is verified separately after merge.
